indexes.//: THE NOTIFICATION BELL. `App.jsx` queries teams/{teamId}/notifications with where('recipientUid','==',uid) + orderBy('timestamp','desc'). An equality filter combined with an orderBy on a DIFFERENT field needs a composite index; Firestore cannot serve it from single-field indexes. The pre-v2 query was where('recipient','==',displayName) on the ROOT notifications collection, so whatever index this project holds for that one does not serve this one. Query scope is COLLECTION rather than COLLECTION_GROUP: a composite index is keyed by collection id, so this covers teams/{any}/notifications without granting cross-team queries.
